name: partmode
tagline: Local-first parametric browser CAD for people and typed agents
description: partmode is a local-first parametric CAD tool that runs in the browser and is designed for both humans and typed agents. Because the CAD model is parametric and the interface is browser-native, AI agents can operate it the same way a person does. It points at a genuinely new direction for open-source CAD: modeling as a collaborative act between people and software agents.
highlights: Parametric CAD that runs locally in the browser
Designed for humans and typed agents alike
Local-first — models stay on your machine
A new direction for open-source CAD
curatorNote: CAD has stayed stubbornly desktop-bound while everything else moved to the browser. Making it parametric, local-first, and agent-operable all at once is a rare convergence of three trends.
